description: Welcome to the brand new Viral Dérive. With updated geometry designed around 29" wheels only and internal routing for your rear brake and a rear dynamo light, the new Dérive is even cleaner and more refined. The Viral Derive is our do it all, bikepacking, backcountry, all country bike made for everything from a rigid fork to a 120mm travel front fork. This frame has mounting points for fenders and racks and three water bottles on all sizes including a 3 pack mount on the underside of the downtube, and a top tube ‘gas tank’ mount. The Dérive is an incredibly versatile machine and capable of anything you throw at it, from your daily mountain bike ride to the Tour Divide, the Dérive is the ultimate ‘last bike you’ll ever buy’. Comes standard with the new Pinion Smart.Shift electronic shifting system, with wiring and battery internally hidden and protected. Compatible with the mechanical gearbox. Reach out to Viral if you’d like to spec it this way.

components.description: IS41 upper/ IS52 lower headset bearings

Smart.Shift Gearbox comes with Gates belt drive, front and rear cogs, forged cranks, TE1 trigger shifter, battery, charger, wiring kit, locking tool, and rear cassette spacer kit
